feature_C_overall_U.question: Which drivers who were born in 1971 and has the fastest lap time on the race? Give id and code of these drivers.
feature_C_overall_U.evidence: born in 1971 refers to year(dob) = 1971; has the fastest lap time refers to fastestLapTime has values
feature_C_overall_U.sql: SELECT D.driverid, D.code FROM drivers AS D JOIN results AS R ON D.driverid = R.driverid WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', D.dob) = '1971' AND NOT R.fastestlaptime IS NULL
